      void DrawingPanel.addEdgeAction(Vertex v)
      action after pressing the addEdgeButton of Vertex v: create a new Vertex in the vertex layer to the right of the vertex layer of v and connect the new vertex to v with a new Edge; make sure that the sum of the capacities of all edges out of Vertex v remains 1
      boolean DiagramManager.createsCrossing(int toLayerNum, Vertex start, int endy)
      check if a possible Edge starting at Vertex start and ending in vertex layer toLayerNum at y-position endy crosses any existing Edge
      void DiagramManager.deleteVertex(Vertex v)
      delete Vertex v, which is allowed if Vertex v has no outEdges
      void DrawingPanel.forwardOrbit(Vertex v)
      recursively find all vertices in the diagram that receive flow from Vertex v (if any); the result is put in the Vector orbit, which must be empty when calling this method!
      void DiagramManager.fuseVertices(Vertex v1, Vertex v2)
      fuse Vertex v1 and Vertex v2 into one new Vertex v2 by adding all Edges into Vertex v1 and all Edges out of Vertex v1 to Vertex v2
      Vertex DiagramManager.fuseWith(Vertex v)
      check if Vertex v, which s being dragged, is sufficiently on top of another vertex (if any)
      double Vertex.getAngle(Vertex v)

      void DiagramManager.insertVertex(Vertex v, Vertex o)
      insert a Vertex v (already created) which will (elsewhere) be connected with an Edge to an existing Vertex o; if o == null, add a root;
      note that the number of the vertex layer into which Vertex v will be inserted must have been set;
      try to avoid crossings between existing Edges and the Edge to be created, and update the vertical layout of the vertex layer into which Vertex v is inserted
      boolean DiagramManager.intersects(Edge e, Vertex st, Point end)
      check if Edge e (or more precise the segment [edgeStart,edgeEnd] intersects the segment starting at the top right of Vertex st and ending in Point end
      boolean DiagramManager.intersectsVertex(Vertex v)
      check if Vertex v, which is being dragged, intersects any other vertex
      int DrawingPanel.isInLayer(Vertex v)
      find out if Vertex v is close to a vertex layer and return the number of that vertex layer or -1 if v is not close to any vertex layer
      void DiagramManager.moveVertexTo(Vertex v, int layerNum)
      move Vertex v to vertex layer layerNum
      void DrawingPanel.showVertexPopup(Vertex v, boolean isLabel)
      show a PopupPanel for the input of flow in roots (appears below the root) or the input of a label for any vertex (appears above the label)
      void DrawingPanel.traceAllSources(Vertex v)
      find all roots connected to Vertex v and put the result in the Vector sources; first find at least one such root, then check if its forward orbit intersects the forward orbit of the roots that were not yet found
      void DrawingPanel.traceBack(Vertex v)
      highlight (recursively) all Edges in the flow diagram that contribute to the flow in Vertex v
      void DrawingPanel.traceSomeSources(Vertex v)
      recursively find at least one root of the flow diagram that is connected to Vertex v, the result is put in the Vector sources, which must be empty when calling this method!
